phrase: A government blacklisted a safety-focused AI company as a risk. It then put its spy chief in charge of a new AI task force.
phraseAlternatives: One AI company kept its safety guardrails and got blacklisted as a risk. A government then put its spy chief in charge of AI oversight.
A country decided a cautious AI company was the dangerous one. Its new AI task force will be run by the spy chief.
Being careful about AI got one company blacklisted as a risk. Running AI oversight now goes to the spy chief.
A safety-focused AI company got blacklisted as a risk. A spy chief now runs the government's new AI task force.
alt: A blueprint drawing of a government building with two doors. The left door has a padlocked shield stamped RISK. The right door has a large eye-shaped badge labeled AI, and beside it a government official raises both arms as if hanging the badge in place. A measurement line spans the building above.

brief.concept: A government protects itself from AI risk by punishing the company that kept its safety guardrails, then hands AI oversight to its own spy chief.
brief.metaphor: A safety shield gets stamped RISK on one side of a building, while right next door an eye-shaped badge goes up over a brand-new office.

cast.who: a government office building with two doors side by side
a safety shield with a small padlock, stamped RISK in red
a government official hanging a large eye-shaped badge over a new door labeled AI

brief.composition: Horizontal split panel on a blueprint grid. Left half: a hand brings a stamp down onto a padlocked shield, leaving a red RISK mark. Right half: the same building's other door gets a large eye-shaped badge hung above a small label reading AI. A thin seam down the middle shows it is one building wearing two faces.
brief.alt: A government building is split in two: on one side a hand stamps RISK in red over a padlocked safety shield, and on the other side an official hangs a large eye-shaped badge above a door labeled AI.
